newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures mixed, nearbys weak.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures mixed, nearbys weak.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended narrowly mixed on Monday, as distant months recovered from the day's lows backed by the yen's weaker tone against the dollar, while nearbys remained weak, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.2 yen per kg lower to 0.2 yen firmer. Benchmark February was 0.2 yen higher at 139.9 yen.

The market started the day on a weaker tone in continued bearish sentiment. But a caution over recent oversold conditions, attracted short-covering especially in distant months later. "The spot September contract failed to rebound much amid concerns over near-term oversupply," one trader said.
